sampleJD.title: Senior AI Product Manager
sampleJD.text:
We're looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to lead our AI-powered platform products. You'll own the product roadmap for our AI/ML features, work closely with engineering and data science teams, and drive 0-to-1 product initiatives.

Responsibilities:
- Define and execute the product strategy for AI-powered features
- Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists on model development and evaluation
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and iteration
- Design evaluation frameworks for AI model quality and product metrics
- Balance innovation velocity with responsible AI practices
- Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, data science, and business teams

Requirements:
- 5+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years on AI/ML products
- Strong technical understanding of ML concepts (training, evaluation, deployment)
- Experience shipping AI products at scale (millions of users)
- Track record of 0-to-1 product launches
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience with LLM/GenAI products preferred

Nice to have:
- Experience with search/recommendation systems
- Background in NLP or computer vision
- Experience with data platform or infrastructure products
- Multi-language product experience

interviewFlows.name: standard_45min
interviewFlows.description: 標準 45 分鐘面試流程，有脈絡的追問

questions.q: 請先簡單自我介紹一下，聊聊你過去的經歷
questions.followUp: 你剛提到的那個 AI 產品，能多說一點當時的挑戰嗎？

questions.q: Can you walk me through your background and what brings you here today?
questions.followUp: Interesting. What was the most impactful project in that journey?

questions.q: 跟我說一個你從零到一打造產品的經驗，你在裡面扮演什麼角色？
questions.followUp: 那個過程中最大的技術風險是什麼？你怎麼處理的？

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to make a difficult trade-off between shipping faster and ensuring quality.
questions.followUp: How did the team react? Would you make the same decision again?

questions.q: 說一個你跟工程師或 data scientist 意見不合的經驗，最後怎麼解決的？
questions.followUp: 如果那個人堅持不讓步，你會怎麼做？

questions.q: Tell me about a time you held leadership accountable while being willing to accept consequences.
講一個你的產品或模型在上線後出問題的經驗，你怎麼處理的？
questions.followUp: 從那次經驗你學到什麼？後來有改變什麼流程嗎？

questions.q: 有沒有一次你做了一個違反直覺的產品決策，結果證明是對的？
使用者抱怨我們的 AI 助手回答很有自信但其實是錯的，你會怎麼處理？
questions.followUp: 那你怎麼衡量 hallucination rate？多高的比率你會拒絕上線？

questions.q: Walk me through how you would design a search system for a platform with millions of creators.
questions.followUp: How would you handle the cold-start problem for new creators with no engagement data?

questions.q: Custom-trained model、fine-tune、還是直接用 third-party API，你怎麼決定？
questions.followUp: 如果老闆說預算只有原來的三分之一，你的策略會怎麼變？

questions.q: How do you write a PRD for a feature whose output is probabilistic and occasionally wrong?
跟我解釋一下 RAG 跟 fine-tuning 的差別，什麼時候該用哪個？
questions.followUp: 你實際做過 RAG 的產品嗎？遇到什麼坑？

questions.q: Walk me through the unit economics of an LLM feature. How do cost per inference and latency change what you build?
你怎麼設計一個 AI 系統的 evaluation harness？offline eval 跟 online eval 分別放什麼？
How would you design guardrails for an agentic system that can take actions on a user's behalf?
一個 stakeholder 想在一個本來運作正常的功能上「加 AI」，你怎麼處理這個對話？
questions.followUp: 如果那個 stakeholder 是 CEO 呢？

questions.q: Design an AI-powered career coach product. What would you build first?
questions.followUp: How would you measure success in the first 90 days?

questions.q: 我們上線了一個 AI tutor 功能，只有不到 10% 的用戶覺得很棒，大多數人覺得普通。你會怎麼做？
questions.followUp: 你會怎麼決定是優化現有功能還是砍掉重來？

questions.q: Pick an AI product you admire. What is the one design decision that made it work?
怎麼決定一個問題需不需要用 AI 來解？什麼時候 rule engine 就夠了？
Notification engagement 連續六週上升，但 time on site 持平或下降。你怎麼看？
How do AI product metrics differ from traditional engagement metrics?
你上線了一個 AI assistant，北極星指標上升了，但你怎麼知道模型品質有沒有在悄悄下降？
questions.followUp: 你會設什麼 alert 來提早發現？

questions.q: How would you measure whether a RAG system is actually working?
你是 Zoom 的 CPO，面對 Teams、Slack、Google Meet 的競爭，你的 AI 策略是什麼？
Improve model accuracy by two points, or ship the current version a month sooner. How do you decide?
如果你有一個 data scientist 但三個 AI feature 在排隊，你怎麼排優先順序？
questions.followUp: 如果三個的 stakeholder 都說自己是最緊急的呢？

questions.q: 你的模型對 90% 的用戶表現很好，但對某個族群表現很差。你會怎麼做？時程多快？
Give me a real example where an ethics concern changed a product decision you made.
怎麼在產品規格階段就把 fairness、privacy、transparency 建進去，而不是上線後才 audit？
為什麼想來我們公司？你覺得你能帶來什麼？
Why are you looking to leave your current role?
你覺得自己最大的優點跟缺點是什麼？
What's your expected compensation range?
你有什麼問題想問我們的嗎？
Do you have any questions for us?

interviewFlows.name: realistic_60min
interviewFlows.description: 模擬真實 60 分鐘面試，含寒暄、閒聊、開玩笑、轉場、壓力測試、估算、私人問題、技術問題等全情境

questions.q: Hi! Can you hear me okay? Great, thanks for joining.
嗨你好，我是 David，是今天面試你的主管。我們先閒聊一下再開始好了
等一下，你的畫面好像卡住了，聽得到嗎？
Sorry, my audio cut out for a second. Can you hear me now?
你今天天氣怎樣？我這邊下大雨
So where are you based? How's the weather there?
你平常有什麼興趣嗎？工作以外的
哈哈好，那我們開始吧
好，那先自我介紹一下吧
questions.followUp: 不錯不錯

questions.q: Walk me through your background.
questions.followUp: Interesting, tell me more about that AI agent you built.

questions.q: 講一個你產品上線後出包的經驗
questions.followUp: 哇那很慘耶，後來怎麼處理的？

questions.q: 有意思
那你覺得你從那次學到最重要的一件事是什麼？
了解了解
嗯…我不太同意耶。你剛剛說的那個做法聽起來太理想化了，實際上根本不可能那麼順利吧？
I'm not convinced that would work at scale. What if the team disagreed?
真的嗎？那如果最後結果是失敗的呢？
如果使用者說你們的 AI 在亂講話，你第一步會做什麼？
questions.followUp: 哈哈對啊 hallucination 真的是大家的噩夢

questions.q: 你剛剛說的那個可以再多解釋一下嗎？我沒聽太清楚
好，那換個方向
你覺得台灣現在大概有多少個 AI PM？
How would you estimate the number of daily active users for Gmail?
如果要量化這個市場的規模，你會怎麼估算？
假設你是 OpenAI 的 CPO，你會砍掉哪個產品線？
If you had unlimited budget but only 3 engineers, what would you build first?
如果你能重新來過，你之前那個專案你會怎麼做不一樣？
一個 stakeholder 想在運作正常的功能上加 AI，你怎麼處理？
questions.followUp: 如果那個人是 CEO 呢？哈哈

questions.q: Nice approach. 那如果資源只有一個 DS 但三個 feature 排隊呢？
好，輕鬆一點。把這支筆賣給我。
If you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?
用三個字形容你自己
好我們休息一下，你要不要喝口水？
話說你是怎麼接觸到 AI 這個領域的？純好奇
你結婚了嗎？有小孩嗎？
How old are you, if you don't mind me asking?
你目前手上有其他 offer 嗎？
When would you be able to start if we move forward?
你的 notice period 是多久？
好差不多了，你有什麼想問我的嗎？
最後還有什麼你想補充的嗎？有沒有什麼我們沒聊到但你覺得很重要的？
Anything else you'd like to add before we wrap up?
謝謝你今天的時間，祝你之後順利
